decks.notes: The main concept of this Aggro Red Deck Wins deck is to deal fast and efficient damage to the opponent. Cards like Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Skullcrack are used to quickly whittle down the opponent's life total while also preventing them from gaining life. Creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Guide provide additional damage and pressure. The deck is designed to be aggressive and relentless, aiming to win the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize or gain control. It prioritizes speed and consistency in dealing damage to secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly playing spells with cascade to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. The goal is to use cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cheat out powerful threats like Crashing Footfalls and Murktide Regent while also using cards like Dead / Gone and Force of Negation to control the board. The deck leverages the cascade mechanic to create explosive turns and put pressure on the opponent early in the game, aiming to quickly close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with Gemstone Caverns and the cascade mechanic to cast powerful spells such as Crashing Footfalls and Murktide Regent. It also utilizes disruption through cards like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute to control the game and protect its threats. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and efficient removal, ending the game quickly before the opponent can recover. The key strategy is to cascade into high-impact spells while maintaining board control and tempo advantage to secure victories.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the "Hammer Time" combo, using equipment cards like Colossus Hammer and Kaldra Compleat to pump up a creature and deal massive damage. Cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Steelshaper's Gift help search for the necessary pieces, while Puresteel Paladin and Sigarda's Aid help equip them for free. The goal is to overwhelm opponents with a powerful, fast combo that can quickly close out the game before they have a chance to react. This deck prioritizes speed and aggression to secure a victory in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on using spells to generate mana and draw cards in order to find and play Goblin Charbelcher as quickly as possible to deal lethal damage to the opponent. Recross the Paths helps to find the necessary combo pieces, while cards like Manamorphose and Desperate Ritual provide additional mana ramp. The deck operates without relying on lands, instead utilizing a mix of spells to power out its win condition. The goal is to assemble the combo quickly and efficiently to overwhelm opponents before they can react.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat big creatures like Archon of Cruelty into play quickly. It also uses cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Ziatora's Proving Ground to set up combo plays. The deck includes a mix of control elements like Mana Leak and Spell Pierce, as well as versatile removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Fire / Ice. The land base is designed to provide consistent access to the necessary colors of mana for the deck's spells and abilities.

The deck focuses on leveraging efficient spells and aggressive creatures to quickly disrupt the opponent and apply pressure. By combining cheap spells like Lightning Bolt and Spell Pierce with powerful threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to control the game tempo and finish off the opponent quickly. Additionally, the use of Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration ensures that the deck maintains card advantage and consistency. The inclusion of counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Snare helps to protect the deck's game plan and disrupt the opponent's strategy.

The deck focuses on efficiently casting spells with low mana cost to quickly overwhelm the opponent with cascading spells. Using cards like Shardless Agent, Crashing Footfalls, and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. With a mix of disruption, card advantage, and threats, the deck seeks to maintain tempo and control the board while continuously applying pressure. The combination of aggro creatures and cascading spells creates a fast-paced gameplay that can catch opponents off-guard and lead to rapid victories.

The deck focuses on playing efficient creatures and using spells to control the board. It utilizes a variety of aggressive creatures with different abilities to pressure the opponent. The inclusion of a companion card provides additional synergy and flexibility. The mana base is carefully constructed to accommodate a wide range of colored spells. The overall strategy is to quickly establish a board presence, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and close out the game with efficient creatures and burn spells.

This deck focuses on milling the opponent's deck as quickly and efficiently as possible using cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Fractured Sanity. It disrupts the opponent's strategy with cards like Archive Trap and Surgical Extraction, while also controlling the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Drown in the Loch. The deck also has card draw and search options with Visions of Beyond and Shelldock Isle. The goal is to mill the opponent's library to win the game before they can assemble their own win condition.

The deck focuses on quickly discarding and utilizing cards from the graveyard to bring out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Cragganwick Cremator. The Underworld Cookbook allows for consistent card draw and graveyard manipulation, while cards like Profane Tutor and Thoughtseize help set up the perfect combo. With a combination of fast mana sources and aggressive creatures like Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar and Voldaren Epicure, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with high-powered threats and efficient plays.

The deck focuses on playing cheap artifacts to quickly flood the board and generate a massive amount of artifacts for synergy with cards like Cranial Plating and Thought Monitor. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a high volume of threats and quickly close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The deck also includes cards like Urza's Saga and Mistvault Bridge to help generate additional value and card advantage to maintain pressure on the opponent.

The key concept of this deck is to combine efficient creatures with burn spells and cheap cantrips to pressure the opponent early and win quickly. By using cards like Monastery Swiftspear, Sprite Dragon, and Soul-Scar Mage to deal direct damage, along with Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to control the board, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. Additionally, the inclusion of Underworld Breach allows for explosive turns by recurring spells from the graveyard. The deck's consistency and speed make it a powerful choice for aggressive players in the Modern format.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to quickly assemble a powerful board state by sacrificing tokens generated by Dwarven Mine or by using Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to create tokens. Teferi, Time Raveler and Leyline Binding provide disruption while Wrenn and Six help with card advantage and recursion. The deck also includes a small toolbox of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending. The goal is to efficiently combo off and overwhelm the opponent with a mixture of creatures and planeswalkers.

The deck revolves around cycling creatures like Street Wraith and Striped Riverwinder to the graveyard, then casting Living End to bring them back onto the battlefield, wiping out the opponent's board and establishing a dominant presence. The archetype focuses on setting up this combo quickly and efficiently, disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Force of Negation and Grief while controlling the board with creatures like Curator of Mysteries. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and control elements to secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty early in the game. It also includes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Pierce to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Wrenn and Six provides additional value and consistency by recurring lands and other key cards. The deck aims to be creative in its approach to assembling its combo pieces and overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures.
